assists.use: write each finding as a Playwright test that fails before the fix and passes after
compact element refs so walking flows costs fewer tokens than full DOM dumps
console errors, network failures and performance traces per flow
screenshot diff with a threshold to confirm a fix changed only what it should

steps.title: List the flows to check
steps.prompt: Read this repository. List 3 to 6 user flows a person would do in this app, focusing on: {{inputs.focus}}. For each: start page, steps, what should happen. Write them to {{run.dir}}/flows.md. Do not edit the repository.

steps.title: Walk the flows in the browser
steps.prompt:
The app is running in your browser pane (the browser tool `panes` gives its dev_port). Walk every flow in {{run.dir}}/flows.md with the browser tools: navigate, snapshot, click, type, and read the console and network after each flow. Record each place the app does not do what the flow says, plus console errors and failed requests. Do not edit any file.

Write the findings to {{run.dir}}/findings.json as a JSON array: [{"severity":"critical|high|medium|low","title","file"?,"line"?,"detail"}] (an empty array when nothing is wrong), and set the output key findings to findings.json.

steps.title: Fix what QA found
steps.prompt: Fix each finding in {{run.dir}}/findings.json in this worktree. For each one, add a test that fails before the fix where the repository has tests. Then run the tests. Add "fixed_by": "fix" to each finding you fixed and write the file back. Commit on the current branch ({{steps.qa.outputs.branch}}). Do not push.
